title: Too much packaging, too little tea
text: I thought this might be a nice way to expand my tea-drinking horizons. There was an interesting variety of teas in my first box, but it was difficult to get the tea out of the packages and into my teapot without spilling. I was mystified by the little cloth bags that I suppose were intended to allow you to steep the tea if you don't have a proper teapot. For me, they were just more clutter to throw away. With containers that allowed me to measure out the dry tea and no excess waste, I might have continued my subscription as the teas were interesting.
label: negative
